statement.p: Plot the point (3,5)\text{,} the origin, some point on the negative x-axis, and some point in quadrant IV.

solution.p: The point (3,5) is 3 units to the right of the origin and 5 units up. The origin itself, (0,0) is where the axes cross. A point on the negative x-axis can be any point directly to the left of the origin, and not up or down from there. A point in quadrant IV can be anything in the lower right region.
